statBlock.name: Githyanki Knight
statBlock.description: Githyanki knights defend Astral Plane territory against intruders. Their sacred silver swords can sever the cords of creatures traveling by Astral Projection.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Silver Sword attacks. The knight can replace one attack with Telekinesis through Spellcasting, if available.
Silver Sword. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) Psychic damage. On a critical hit against a target in an astral body, the knight can sever the cord tethering that body to the target's material body in place of the damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Intelligence (spell save DC 13), with no components.
At will. Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible).
2/day each. Nondetection (self only) and Tongues.
1/day each. Plane Shift and Telekinesis.
sections.Bonus actions: Misty Step (2/day). Cast Misty Step using Intelligence, with no components.

statBlock.name: Githyanki Warrior
statBlock.description: Githyanki warriors fight with blades that channel psionic force. Many serve Vlaakith in campaigns against mind flayers, githzerai, and other enemies.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Psi Blade attacks.
Psi Blade. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Intelligence, with no components.
At will. Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible).
2/day. Nondetection (self only).
sections.Bonus actions: Misty Step (2/day). Cast Misty Step using Intelligence, with no components.

statBlock.name: Githzerai Monk
statBlock.description: Githzerai monks practice physical discipline alongside psionics. Some leave their sanctuaries to test that training in harsher parts of the multiverse.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Psi Strike attacks.
Psi Strike. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Wisdom, with no components.
At will. Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible).
1/day. See Invisibility.
sections.Bonus actions: Psi-Powered Leap (2/day). Cast Jump using Wisdom, with no components.
sections.Reactions: Psionic Defense (2/day total). When the trigger for Feather Fall or Shield occurs, cast that spell using Wisdom, with no components. Both spells use the same two daily uses.

statBlock.name: Githzerai Zerth
statBlock.description: Zerths carry on Zerthimon's teachings. They hone their psionics in githzerai sanctuaries and can travel among the planes.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Psi Strike attacks.
Psi Strike. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) Psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one of the following spells using Wisdom (spell save DC 14), with no components.
At will. Mage Hand (the hand is Invisible).
1/day each. Phantasmal Killer (level 6), Plane Shift, and See Invisibility.
sections.Bonus actions: Psi-Powered Leap (2/day). Cast Jump using Wisdom, with no components.
sections.Reactions: Psionic Defense (2/day total). When the trigger for Feather Fall or Shield occurs, cast that spell using Wisdom, with no components. Both spells use the same two daily uses.

statBlock.name: Drider
statBlock.description: Driders combine the features of spiders and humanoids, often drow transformed by Lolth. Their climbing and web magic let them hunt from cavern ceilings or dense forest canopies.

sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces or ceilings without an ability check.
Sunlight Sensitivity. While in sunlight, the drider has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
Web Walker. Webs do not restrict the drider's movement. It knows where every other creature touching the same web is.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Foreleg or Poison Burst in any combination.
Foreleg. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.
Poison Burst. Ranged attack, +6 to hit, range 120 ft. A hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) Poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Magic of the Spider Queen (Recharge 5–6). Cast Darkness, Faerie Fire, or Web using Wisdom (spell save DC 14), with no Material components.

statBlock.name: Kenku
statBlock.description: A curse left these birdfolk flightless and able to speak only by imitating sounds. Kenku use mimicry to signal allies or lure foes toward an ambush.

sections.Traits: Mimicry. The kenku can imitate sounds it has heard, including voices. A listener can recognize an imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Actions: Shadow Blade. Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) Necrotic damage. The blade returns magically to the kenku's hand immediately after a ranged attack.
sections.Bonus actions: Eldritch Lantern (Recharge 4–6). Cast Faerie Fire using Intelligence (spell save DC 10).

statBlock.name: Winged Kobold
statBlock.description: Kobolds call their winged kin urds and often take the wings as a sign of draconic favor. An urd can spit elemental energy while staying out of melee reach.

sections.Traits:
Pack Tactics. The kobold has Advantage when attacking a creature if an ally within 5 ft. of that target isn't Incapacitated.
Sunlight Sensitivity. While in sunlight, the kobold has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
sections.Actions:
Dragon-Tooth Blade. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
Chromatic Spittle. Ranged attack, +5 to hit, range 30 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) damage. The kobold chooses Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.
sections.Habitats: Arctic, Coastal, Desert, Forest, Hill, Mountain, Swamp, Underdark, Urban.
